verdicts.rationale: Verified: scripts/check-api-surface.py already diffs the public API surface between merge base and head via javap and fails removals without migration notes; it runs in CI. The backlog entry was stale and was removed in the follow-up commit.

Verified: docs/en/user-guide.md documents that orThrow() rethrows the first recorded execution failure before any cancellation is reported, and that failedTaskResult() returns the first failed element. The pure-timeout semantics are settled and documented, so the open-decision entry was removed in the follow-up commit.

design/decision-log.md holds conclusions and rejection reasons of retired directions, not open questions. The header now routes open design questions to design/proposal/ only; fixed in the follow-up commit.

The refactoring-review T2 row still routed deferred findings to BACKLOG.md generically. The narrowed backlog takes release-gating suggestions only; the routing row was updated in the follow-up commit.

The uncalibrated-threshold concern is recorded in adr/0010 itself ('the always-on WARNING may be noisy in production; the period and thresholds are not calibrated under real load'); the BACKLOG id was only a pointer in a dated decision record that is never rewritten, and the deletion of the old inventory was explicitly directed by the maintainer. The risk remains tracked in the ADR.
